newsitem.title: USA: US Mint buys 2,499,000 kg zinc at avg $1.3782/kg. [CORRECTED 19:44 GMT]
newsitem.headline: US Mint buys 2,499,000 kg zinc at avg $1.3782/kg. [CORRECTED 19:44 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects amount bought in the headline and text from 1,351,000 kg of zinc.)
U.S. Mint said Monday it bought 2,499,000 kg of special high grade zinc from four companies at an average price of $1.3782 per kg.
It said it bought 1,156,000 kg zinc in three lots from Hochschild Partners at an average price of $1.3742 per kg. It bought 195,000 kg from Ore & Chemical Co for $1.3822 per kg.

Trademet Inc sold 944,000 (corrects amount) kg of zinc to the Mint in six (corrects from three) lots at an average $1.3747 (corrects price) per kg, the Mint said. The Mint purchased the final 204,000 kg of zinc from Bal Metals Inc at $1.3680 per kg. Earlier on Monday, the Mint incorrectly reported it had bought only 1,351,000 kg of zinc.
